## Specific task description

Task instruction: Take the small smooth brown-rimmed bowl, set it down, and stack the smooth bowl with glossy finish on top.

Task description: Smooth brown-rimmed bowls sit at the front left and on the right. Stack them into one pile. The instruction specifies the small bowl below and the glossy bowl above.

Success criteria: The lower bowl rests on the table and the upper bowl sits low on it, with their bodies approximately overlapping horizontally to form a stack near the table. Both grippers must be open.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping a rim section facing open tabletop, with one finger inside the bowl and one outside and pads contacting the wall below the rim. Adjust the opening for local wall thickness and entry clearance to reduce pushing the bowl.
- Before closing, confirm the fingers are on opposite sides of the bowl wall rather than pressing only the rim top. Smooth walls slip easily; test-lift at low height and restore table support before adjusting if sliding appears.
- Keep the bowl opening facing up during transport and adjust its pose in an open area. Leave room for the bowl and gripper to pass around the tall bottle on the left and the flowerpot, books, and trophy behind it.
- During stacking approach, aim the upper bowl bottom at the middle of the lower opening. Correct obvious offsets before contact, then lower in small steps. If rims meet, stop pressing down to avoid overturning the lower bowl.
- Leave finger-withdrawal clearance during placement to avoid trapping them between bowl walls. Release after the lower bowl supports the upper, then withdraw clear of the rim to reduce tipping.
